name: Sheen Falls Lodge
insider_take: This 17th-century estate turned luxury lodge sits majestically on 300 acres where the Sheen River cascades into Kenmare Bay, offering one of Ireland's most spectacular waterfall views right from your room.
whats_special: The hotel's private salmon fishing beats are legendary among anglers, while the on-site La Cascade restaurant has earned acclaim for elevating traditional Irish cuisine. The property features Ireland's only hotel with a working waterfall as its centerpiece, plus an award-winning spa housed in converted stables.
pro_tip: Book a riverside suite during salmon season (May-September) for front-row seats to watch fish leaping up the falls – it's a natural spectacle few hotels in the world can offer.
dont_miss: The Ring of Kerry starts practically at the hotel's doorstep, while nearby Kenmare town offers some of Ireland's finest artisan shops and traditional pubs. Take the hotel's vintage Land Rover for a private tour of the Beara Peninsula – one of Ireland's most unspoiled coastal drives.
pros: Spectacular waterfall and river views from luxury estate setting
Award-winning fine dining restaurant with exceptional culinary experience
Full-service spa and wellness facilities for ultimate relaxation
Extensive outdoor activities including salmon fishing and estate walks
cons: Remote location requires longer travel times to reach
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive estate experience
